import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print("NO")
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    if n == 0:
        print("NO")
        return
    
    seen = set()
    index = 1
    
    for i in range(n):
        m = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        
        if m == 0:
            arr_tuple = ()
        else:
            arr = list(map(int, data[index:index + m]))
            index += m
            arr_tuple = tuple(arr)
        
        if arr_tuple in seen:
            print("YES")
            return
        seen.add(arr_tuple)
    
    print("NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
